en.stack: Node.js, NestJS, AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, API Gateway, Docker, Jest
en.title: Serverless flows driven by events
en.summary: At Serasa, I built serverless, event-driven flows on AWS and the NestJS services around them, in a microservices architecture.
en.context: Serasa's systems ran as microservices, with API Gateway routing the requests between them, and some services had to run many tasks at once.
en.role: Backend developer: I built the event-driven flows, the NestJS services and their tests.
en.built: Event-driven flows with AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS and Step Functions. Modular NestJS services with REST APIs for the integrations between services, with attention to performance, security and concurrency, containerized with Docker. Jest suites cover them with unit and end-to-end tests, the GraphQL APIs included.

pt.title: Fluxos serverless orientados a eventos
pt.summary: Na Serasa, construí fluxos serverless e orientados a eventos na AWS e os serviços NestJS em volta deles, numa arquitetura de microsserviços.
pt.context: Os sistemas da Serasa rodavam como microsserviços, com o API Gateway roteando as requisições entre eles, e alguns serviços precisavam executar muitas tarefas ao mesmo tempo.
pt.role: Desenvolvedor backend: construí os fluxos orientados a eventos, os serviços NestJS e os testes deles.
pt.built: Fluxos orientados a eventos com AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS e Step Functions. Serviços NestJS modulares, com APIs REST para as integrações entre serviços, com atenção a desempenho, segurança e concorrência, conteinerizados com Docker. Suítes do Jest os cobrem com testes unitários e de ponta a ponta, inclusive as APIs GraphQL.

es.context: Los sistemas de Serasa corrían como microservicios, con API Gateway enrutando las solicitudes entre ellos, y algunos servicios tenían que ejecutar muchas tareas a la vez.
